semantics.zero_cost_edge: A legal drag that exits and clears exactly one visible layer.
semantics.one_cost_edge: A legal drag ending at an internal resting position without clearing a layer.
semantics.objective_equivalence: Every complete route clears the fixed initial layer load, so totalDrags = clearLoad + nonExitDrags; minimizing total drags and minimizing reposition overhead are equivalent.
semantics.proof_rule: A floor is proven only after every state reachable with reposition cost < target has been exhausted.
semantics.bounded_dfs_rule: The default memory-bounded DFS exhausts every state with non-exit cost <= target-1; zero-cost edges strictly clear one layer, and bounded transposition eviction may repeat work but cannot remove a legal branch.
semantics.zero_cost_closure_rule: When enabled, a state with a legal free clear follows one deterministic free clear before considering reposition edges, but only on single-layer levels without shutters, elevators, conveyors, or shutter-bound blocks. In that scope a free clear removes space and only decreases monotone counters, so taking it immediately cannot remove a solution or increase its reposition cost.
semantics.symmetry_rule: Interchangeable-block canonicalization is opt-in, normalizes shape point order, binds every discovered block-id reference, and disables interchangeability for unknown top-level level fields.
semantics.relaxed_bound_rule: The relaxed-parking bound is opt-in and is used only without conveyors/elevators. Root-only mode invokes it once at the initial proof state; an uncertified root result immediately falls back to the ordinary bounded search. A per-call state or memory cap is unproven and never authorizes pruning.
semantics.state_identity: Block presence/order/id/position/current color/layer stack/frozen counters, gate frozen counters, and shutter counters; conveyor movement is applied after each clear exactly as in levelSolver.ts.
semantics.inconclusive_rule: A state cap with frontier below target is inconclusive. It is never converted into a pass or fail proof.
semantics.playability_rule: A lower bound is publishable only when accompanied by a completion route replayed through PuzzleModel.
semantics.supported_scope: Matches src/core/levelSolver.ts semantics. Any mechanism unsupported by that solver is outside this prototype's proof scope.

proof.discovered_states_semantics: retained transposition entries at end; evicted entries may be re-explored without weakening correctness

certification.note: Do not publish the target as guaranteed unless both the lower-bound proof and a replayed completion witness are present.
